comments.author: jim nguyen
comments.text:
great ways of answering questions , but in the IELTS test there are numerous tough questions , some of which are difficult to answer smoothly ......

Here are the topics with popular questions asked in IELTS , let's practise to master ourselves in speaking

1. Your Work or Your Studies

... [long part-1 question bank: general description of your job, feelings about the job, working with others, work tools, training at work, future, your first day at work; then the same for Your Studies - subject choice, school/university, liking/disliking, easy and difficult subjects, interesting, specific course content, study efficiency, study tools, studying with others, future]

[remainder of the question list archived separately]
